title: Mushroom Risotto
author: Claude
description: Browned mushrooms folded into a creamy parmesan risotto. Worth the stirring.
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in a hot pan, season and set aside.
In the same pan, soften the onion in half the butter, add the garlic and the rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is creamy and just tender (18–20 minutes).
Fold in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter and the parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes before serving.
